country.evidence_quote: From November 29 to December 7, 2024, Taekwondo Club Avgusta in Stara Zagora, Bulgaria, hosted an inspiring Erasmus+ youth exchange titled "Exploring Taekwondo Across Cultures." Participants from Romania, Italy, and Bulgaria came together for an incredible journey that explored the world of Taekwondo, fitness, healthy living, and cultural exchange. Over the course of this week, we not only learned martial arts but also gained valuable insights into teamwork, resilience, and global connection.
